title: bheka.key.shredded.v1
description: Emitted by eride-vault when a tenant key version is irreversibly destroyed. All ciphertext depending on this key version is permanently unrecoverable after this event. This is the POPIA s14 retention enforcement mechanism (CANON section 6). By definition this event is never repeated for the same tenant_key_id (010_EVENT_BUS_AND_TOPICS section 2). Consumers (e.g. bheka-case) must mark all evidence rows with this key_version as crypto_shredded.

event_id.description: UUIDv7. De-duplicate consumers on this field.

occurred_at.description: ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC at which the Vault completed the shred.

tenant_id.description: UUIDv7 of the tenant whose key was shredded.

key_version.description: The exact key version that was destroyed. Matches tenant_keys.key_version.

shred_reason.description: Why the shred was performed. Used by compliance pipeline for regulator reporting.

role.description: Role held by this approver at time of authorisation.

authorised_by.description: Two distinct approvers required per 009_API_SURFACE section 13.
